review: Dawn Gregor is a Walpurgis Night exclusive Burn tremor ID with strong support capabilities. Unlike his other 2 Dawn teammates, his offensive capabilities are quite lacking, yet he still deserves some attention for his strong status effect infliction. Let’s take a closer look at his kit. Starting with his unique effects, he has quite a few of those. - Light of Daybreak - His unique stacks are just like Dawn Faust. However, aside from S3-2 usage, they also enhance his Burn infliction and give him extra coins for S1 and S2. Can gain up to 20 stacks per turn with a max stack of 30 (hard-capping rotation of S3-2 to 4 turns if he is alone, 3 turns if 1 Dawn Office ally is present, 2 turns if 2 are present). Max effectiveness will be at 20 for infliction and extra coins. He also starts Burning himself due to stacks, but it doesn’t matter much aside from healing purposes since he has Burn damage
